harm_description: Age and sex rules automatically prevent access to employment consideration
existing_controls: None documented in the public source
proposed_controls: Disable automatic rejection and test every eligibility rule against protected-group policy
human_oversight: Independent recruiter reviews every proposed rejection and an appeal reviewer can reinstate the application
monitoring_metric: Selection-rate ratio and automatic-rejection count by relevant group
trigger_threshold: Any automatic rejection or approved disparity threshold breach
response_action: Stop screening release preserve logs notify compliance and manually re-review affected applications

harm_description: Historical patterns can make gender-correlated resume features reduce candidate ranking
proposed_controls: Remove protected proxies use representative evaluation sets and publish subgroup performance
human_oversight: Recruiter receives ranked evidence but must review a random sample and all near-threshold candidates
monitoring_metric: Subgroup recall and recruiter override rate
trigger_threshold: Subgroup recall gap above 5 percentage points for two evaluation runs
response_action: Block promotion to production investigate features retrain and require independent re-validation
